title: SharkNinja Set to Join S&P 500; Others to Join S&P MidCap 400 and S&P SmallCap 600
summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices will make the following changes to the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600: S&P MidCap 400 constituent SharkNinja Inc. (NYSE: SN) will replace AES Corp. (NYSE: AES) in...
body_markdown:
NEW YORK


, Nov. 23, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- S&P Dow Jones Indices will make the following changes to the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600:


- S&P MidCap 400 constituent SharkNinja Inc. (NYSE: SN) will replace AES Corp. (NYSE: AES) in the S&P 500, S&P SmallCap 600 constituent Paycom Software Inc. (NYSE: PAYC) will replace SharkNinja in the S&P MidCap 400, and Guardian Pharmacy Services Inc. (NYSE: GRDN) will replace Paycom Software in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Wednesday, December 2. A consortium, including Global Infrastructure Partners and EQT Infrastructure, are acquiring AES in a deal expected to be completed soon pending final conditions.
- Transocean Ltd. (NYSE: RIG) will replace Valaris Limited (NYSE: VAL) in the S&P MidCap 400 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, December 1. Transocean is acquiring Valaris in a deal expected to close soon pending final conditions.
- Tecnoglass Holdings Inc. (NYSE: TGLS) will replace MarineMax Inc. (NYSE: HZO) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, December 1. Blackstone Infrastructure Portfolio Company and Safe Harbor are acquiring MarineMax in a deal expected to close soon, pending final closing conditions.
